members.name: tvg_animation_set_frame
members.brief: Specifies the current frame in the animation.

params.name: no
params.description: The index of the animation frame to be displayed. The index should be less than the tvg_animation_get_total_frame().

retvals.description: if the given `no` is the same as the current frame value.
The picture data does not support animations.

notes: For efficiency, ThorVG ignores updates to the new frame value if the difference from the current frame value is less than 0.001. In such cases, it returns `Result::InsufficientCondition`. Values less than 0.001 may be disregarded and may not be accurately retained by the Animation.

members.name: tvg_animation_get_picture
members.brief: Retrieves a picture instance associated with this animation instance.
description: This function provides access to the picture instance that can be used to load animation formats, such as lot. After setting up the picture, it can be added to the designated canvas, enabling control over animation frames with this Animation instance.

params.name: animation
params.description: A animation object to the animation object.

members.returns: A picture instance that is tied to this animation.
warnings: The picture instance is owned by Animation. It should not be deleted manually.

members.name: tvg_animation_get_frame
members.brief: Retrieves the current frame number of the animation.

params.name: no
params.description: The current frame number of the animation, between 0 and totalFrame() - 1.

members.name: tvg_animation_get_total_frame
members.brief: Retrieves the total number of frames in the animation.

params.name: cnt
params.description: The total number of frames in the animation.

notes: If the Picture is not properly configured, this function will return 0.

members.name: tvg_animation_get_duration
members.brief: Retrieves the duration of the animation in seconds.

params.name: duration
params.description: The duration of the animation in seconds.

notes: If the Picture is not properly configured, this function will return 0.

members.name: tvg_animation_set_segment
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_animation_set_segment(Tvg_Animation animation, float begin, float end)
members.brief: Specifies the playback segment of the animation.
description: The set segment is designated as the play area of the animation. This is useful for playing a specific segment within the entire animation. After setting, the number of animation frames and the playback time are calculated by mapping the playback segment as the entire range.

retvals.description: In case the animation is not loaded.

notes: Animation allows a range from 0.0 to the total frame. `end` should not be lower than `begin`.
If a marker has been specified, its range will be disregarded.

members.name: tvg_animation_get_segment
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_animation_get_segment(Tvg_Animation animation, float* begin, float* end)
members.brief: Gets the current segment range information.

retvals.description: In case the animation is not loaded.

params.name: animation
params.description: The Tvg_Animation object to be deleted.
